_comment: Shared by tests/js/font-fallback-stack.test.js and tests/phpunit/Unit/FontFallbackStackTest.php so the PHP resolver and its JS twin stay identical (style-manager#219). Stacks mirror the Pixelgrade Cloud font categories.

sans-serif.fallback_stack: "SF Pro Text", "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

neutral: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

cases.name: no details (system font value)
Google serif
Google sans
cases.expected: "SF Pro Text", "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

cases.name: Google display
Google monospace
Google handwriting
category case and spacing
category alias from the catalog
built-in alias sans
cases.expected: "SF Pro Text", "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

cases.name: built-in alias mono
a substring of an alias is not a match
cases.expected: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

cases.name: cloud font with its own curated stack
display font tagged serif gets the serif stack
display font tagged sans gets the sans stack
cases.expected: "SF Pro Text", "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

cases.name: display font without a classification tag stays display
a tag never overrides a specific category
cases.expected: "SF Pro Text", "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

cases.name: tags as cloud objects
Font Library family with a bare generic gets its category stack
Font Library family with its own stack keeps it
Font Library cursive generic
Font Library family without a generic uses the Google catalog
unknown category gets the neutral stack
cases.expected: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

cases.name: no category and no stack gets the neutral stack
cases.expected: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

cases.name: no category keeps an own stack
known category missing from the list falls back to its generic
handwriting missing from the list falls back to cursive
display missing from the list gets the neutral stack
cases.expected: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif
